news.analysis: Lawrence didn't have to do much to get his team the win in this game, much like Sunday when he faced the Colts. His one touchdown came on a breakaway play by Parker Washington, who was quiet aside from that play. Lawrence gets another easy matchup next week against the Titans. They will be well rested, however, as Tennessee is on a bye, but the Jaguars have a mini-bye themselves thanks to the Thursday game.
news.contents: Trevor Lawrence completed 16 of 26 passes for 242 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 33-10 win over the Ravens. He also ran once for -1 yard.
